name: tshtml-monorepo
description: TypeScript HTML template engine with webpack loader support

scripts.build: npm run build -w tshtml && npm run build -w tshtml-loader
scripts.test: npm run test -w tshtml && npm run test -w tshtml-loader
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w tshtml && npm run coverage -w tshtml-loader
scripts.clean: rimraf tshtml/lib tshtml-loader/lib tshtml/coverage tshtml-loader/coverage .nyc_output coverage

author: LOGEX Group
